# Erdos.p677 — Erdős problem 677

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/677
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/677.lean`, theorem `erdos_677`, AMS 11).

Denote by $M(n, k)$ the least common multiple of the finite set $\{n+1, \dotsc, n+k\}$.
Is it true that for all $m \geq n + k$, we get $M(m, k) \neq M(n, k)$?

## Statement
∀ (m n k : ℕ), k > 0 → m ≥ n + k → lcmInterval m k ≠ lcmInterval n k

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
